start.title: [TODO:fr] Jesus Passes By
start.text:
[TODO:fr] Jesus walks the road to Jericho.
The whole town comes to see.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Stay safe in your tax booth
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] He may pass and never return.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Do Not Hide
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] This moment will not come again.
Go and see.

crowd.title: [TODO:fr] Too Short to See
crowd.text:
[TODO:fr] The crowd is tall and tight.
You cannot see him at all.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Force will not open the way.
[TODO:fr] Do not turn back so soon.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Look for another way to see

push_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not by Force
push_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The crowd will not part for you.
Find another way.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Look for another way to see

quit_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Do Not Give Up
quit_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] He is close. Just a little courage.
Keep going.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Look for another way to see

tree.title: [TODO:fr] The Sycamore
tree.text:
[TODO:fr] An old sycamore leans over the road.
Its branches reach low.

shame_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Climb Anyway
shame_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Pride keeps you from seeing him.
Let it go.

seen.title: [TODO:fr] He Looks Up
seen.text:
[TODO:fr] Jesus stops and looks straight at you.
"Zacchaeus, come down."

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Climb down at once with joy

hide_tree_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Come Down
hide_tree_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] He is calling you by name.
Do not be afraid.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Climb down at once with joy

invite.title: [TODO:fr] I Must Stay With You
invite.text:
[TODO:fr] "Today I must stay at your house."
The words shake your heart.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Today is the day of grace.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Welcome Him
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] He is not ashamed of you.
Open your door.

bargain_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Today
bargain_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Grace comes today, not tomorrow.
Receive him now.

grumble.title: [TODO:fr] A Sinner's House
grumble.text:
[TODO:fr] The crowd mutters in disbelief.
"He goes in to a sinner's house."

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Their voices cannot define you now.

stare_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Stand Tall
stare_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Their judgment is not the last word.
Grace is.

repent.title: [TODO:fr] I Will Make It Right
repent.text:
[TODO:fr] Something new rises in you.
Wealth no longer holds your heart.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Keep your gold and stay quiet
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] A changed heart cannot stay silent.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Give half to the poor today

keep_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Let It Go
keep_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Closed hands cannot hold grace.
Open them.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Give half to the poor today

feast_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Bear Fruit
feast_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Real change shows in your hands.
Give freely.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Give half to the poor today

ending.title: [TODO:fr] Salvation Has Come
ending.text:
[TODO:fr] "Today salvation has come to this house."
You are seen, you are restored.
